item.text: The existing code already defines the operator set and CRC32 bucket scheme, so I’ll move those helpers with the evaluator. I also found two behavior gaps to fix during the move: rule iteration uses a map despite SQL rank ordering, and rollout lookup skips an exact cutoff boundary.

header='''package storage

import (
    \"context\"

    \"fmt\"

    flipt \"github.com/markphelps/flipt/rpc\"
    \"github.com/sirupsen/logrus\"

// Evaluator evaluates feature flags for entities.
type Evaluator interface {
    Evaluate(ctx context.Context, r *flipt.EvaluationRequest) (*flipt.EvaluationResponse, error)
}

var _ Evaluator = &EvaluatorStorage{}

// EvaluatorStorage evaluates flags using SQL storage.
type EvaluatorStorage struct {
    logger logrus.FieldLogger
    builder sq.StatementBuilderType
}

// NewEvaluatorStorage creates an EvaluatorStorage.
func NewEvaluatorStorage(logger logrus.FieldLogger, builder sq.StatementBuilderType) *EvaluatorStorage {
    return &EvaluatorStorage{
        logger: logger.WithField(\"storage\", \"evaluator\"),
        builder: builder,
    }
}

'''

item.text:
Implemented the evaluation split. [EvaluatorStorage](/app/storage/evaluator.go) now handles ranked rule matching, typed constraints, and deterministic CRC32 variant selection. [Server.Evaluate](/app/server/evaluator.go) delegates through the new `Evaluator` interface; `RuleStore` no longer implements evaluation.

Added regression coverage for rule rank, zero rollouts, cutoff boundaries, operator normalization, and request IDs. `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./...` passes.
